_meta.description: Dataset comparison facts for existing public dental image datasets (CVPR27 dental-unified). Every non-null field is backed by an evidence quote (paper abstract in litreview/papers.json via bibkey, open-access full text via Europe PMC / arXiv HTML, or the official page). Unknown -> null.

conventions.tasks: true only when the paper/page states the task or annotation type; null = not stated (never inferred, e.g. polygons implying boxes); false = not used
conventions.duplicate_or_leakage_audit_reported: true = paper reports duplicate removal, a leak check, or a patient-level split (see note: none is a cross-split copy-lineage audit); false = we read the open-access full text and found no statement (negative_check entry, quote null); null = full text not checked
conventions.licence: verbatim data licence/terms only; the article's own CC licence is NOT recorded as the data licence

_meta.quote_check: All quotes were string-matched (whitespace-normalised) against the papers.json abstract (bibkey sources), the Europe PMC full-text XML (europepmc sources), the arXiv PDF text (AlphaDent) or the downloaded HTML page (other URLs). 'comment' entries are our annotations, not quotes.
